entry.title: Order Flow Imbalance Study
entry.summary: Atom fixture with ETag and Last-Modified metadata. The hypothesis is that order flow imbalance leads short-horizon returns. The signals used are order flow imbalance and cancel-to-trade ratio. Entry is taken when imbalance stays positive across two observation windows. The position is exited on imbalance decay or at the end of the observation window. The data required is level 2 order book snapshots. The risks noted are queue position uncertainty and venue latency.

entry.title: Microstructure Mean Reversion
entry.summary: Short-horizon research metadata. The hypothesis is that microstructure mean reversion follows an extreme quote move. The signals used are the mid-price deviation and the trade sign run length. Entry is taken when the deviation exceeds the documented threshold. The position is exited when the mid-price returns to its rolling mean. The data required is level 1 quotes and trade prints. The risks noted are regime change and thin liquidity at the open.
